english: Using your <prismatic Prismatic /> Grenade Ability while <prismatic Transcendent /> consumes all stacks of 'Stack 'Em Up' and grants 6% <prismatic Prismatic /> Grenade Energy per stack.

source.text:
4 Piece | Burn 'Em Down

On Prismatic Grenade Ability Usage while Transcendent:
Consumes all stacks of Stack 'Em Up to grant ~6% Prismatic Grenade Energy per stack
6% | 12% | 18% | 24% | 30% Prismatic Grenade Energy.
